nodes.label: Atom UI Concept
nodes.rationale: Smallest, indivisible UI building blocks in Basis; build strictly on basis-tokens, foundational primitives, and Compose Foundation

nodes.label: Component UI Concept
nodes.rationale: Feature-level UI structures composed of molecules and atoms, owning layout, state, and data handling

nodes.label: Molecule UI Concept
nodes.rationale: Small, reusable groups of atoms that execute a single cohesive interaction or job

nodes.label: Basis Modular Architecture
nodes.rationale: Gather context through knowledge and context graphs rather than unguided walking. Strict module DAG: basis-theme -> basis-components -> demo-app.

nodes.label: Basis Custom Detekt Ruleset
nodes.rationale: Custom Detekt rules enforcing MandatoryBraces, BlankLineBeforeReturn, BlankLineBeforeLastStatement, VersionCatalogUsage, LifecycleConsistency.

nodes.label: VerifyAll Quality Gate
nodes.rationale: Single verification entry point that collects all subproject tasks and included build checks (build-logic detekt/ktlint) so no gate is silently bypassed

nodes.label: Compliance Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: Requires single verification command ./gradlew verifyAll to pass all assemble, test, lint, detekt, ktlintCheck, and releaseApiCheck across modules before concluding tasks

nodes.label: Conflict Resolution Policy
nodes.rationale: Requires stopping before code modification when encountering a rule conflict, naming the specific rule, explaining the breakage, and awaiting explicit user guidance without silently complying or working around

nodes.label: KDoc Documentation Standards
nodes.rationale: Mandates 100% public symbol KDoc coverage, property-level contracts, bracketed symbol references, and third-person neutral voice to satisfy AndroidX/JetBrains library standards

nodes.label: Basis Public API Conventions
nodes.rationale: Requires Basis-prefix for public entrypoints and composables, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constants, 1:1 declaration match to file name, single-source principle, and extension functions on existing types to ensure consistent, non-divergent API design

nodes.label: Testing Tasks & Execution
nodes.rationale: Clarifies testing tasks: ./gradlew test runs unit tests across all modules, while ./gradlew tests runs both unit and Android instrumentation tests on the first available connected device via adb or ANDROID_SERIAL

nodes.label: Detekt vs Ktlint Tooling Division
nodes.rationale: Ktlint owns mechanical formatting rewrite rules via editorconfig; Detekt owns semantic AST/type-resolution rules (unused/wildcard imports, cognitive complexity) to avoid duplicate conflicting reports

nodes.label: Binary Compatibility Validation
nodes.rationale: releaseApiCheck diffs public API against committed baseline in basis.api to prevent inadvertent breaking changes or accidental API leaks

nodes.label: Git Branch and Conventional Commit Workflow
nodes.norm_label: git branch and conventional commit workflow
nodes.rationale: Standardizes branch naming and conventional commit syntax with issue binding to drive automated PR labeling and validation workflows

nodes.label: basisClickable Accessibility Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Enforces 48dp physical touch target hitbox via basisMinTouchTarget without altering layout placement, handles Space/Enter key activation.

nodes.label: basisFocusRing Accessibility Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Satisfies WCAG 2.4.7 and 2.4.11 by drawing 2dp stroke with 2dp outward offset guaranteeing >= 3:1 contrast against adjacent surfaces.

nodes.label: basisMinTouchTarget Touch Target Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Enforces WCAG 2.5.5 / 2.5.8 48dp touch target hitbox floor for small visual elements without shifting layout.

nodes.label: basisSelectable Accessibility Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Manages single-choice selection states with Role.RadioButton or Role.Tab, keyboard Space/Enter handling, and 48dp touch floor.

nodes.label: basisToggleable Accessibility Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Exposes boolean checked state semantics to assistive tech with Role.Checkbox or Role.Switch and 48dp touch target.

nodes.label: Foundation Composition Pattern
nodes.rationale: Composables do not inherit from base classes; they build higher-order components by piping foundation modifiers into composable slots.

nodes.label: Component Style Resolution
nodes.rationale: Dynamic component style resolution through ControlIntent patches and resolveComponentStyle.

nodes.label: Basis Dependency Layout and Architecture
nodes.rationale: Dependencies flow strictly in one direction: basis-theme -> basis-components -> demo-app, with build-logic as an included build.

nodes.label: T0/T1/T2 Component Architecture Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: T0 private primitives -> T1 public fundamentals -> T2 core controls composed strictly from T0/T1 and resolved tokens.

nodes.label: basisBorder Design and Accessibility Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Pair with outlineVariant for subtle container boundaries. Ensure adjacent container fill and border achieve sufficient contrast.

nodes.label: basisSurface Elevation Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Provides visual container canvas; derives surface tokens with WCAG AA contrast against LocalBasisContentColor; renders dark mode elevation via tonal luminance steps.

nodes.label: Docs Runtime Intent Resolution Verification
nodes.rationale: Validates in-browser JS bundling and JSON intent resolution output for valid, invalid, and malformed intents.

nodes.label: ColorSpec Intake Types
nodes.rationale: Accepts Hex, Argb, and Hsl color specifications with up to 3 supporting secondary colors.

nodes.label: Brand Presence Levels
nodes.rationale: Controls how prominently brand hue tints surfaces and components across Subtle, Balanced, Strong, and Dominant levels.

nodes.label: Basis Core Architecture Features
nodes.rationale: Intent-driven resolution, OKLCH perceptually uniform color modeling, accessibility by construction, single choke point styling.

nodes.label: Component Naming and Declaration Conventions
nodes.rationale: Basis prefix reserved strictly for public API root entrypoints; Basis<Name>Defaults holds constants; 1:1 file match; token terminology enforced.

nodes.label: Component Authoring Verification Checklist
nodes.rationale: Requires ktlintCheck, detekt zero-issues, releaseApiDump public API tracking, and verifyAll pass before publishing.

nodes.label: Basis Versioning Policy
nodes.rationale: Pre-1.0 (0.x.y) allows breaking changes with release note guidance; post-1.0 adheres strictly to semver; deprecations kept for at least 1 cycle.

nodes.label: basisClearAndSetSemantics Accessibility Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Wipes accessibility subtree to prevent TalkBack from announcing redundant internal sub-nodes on compound items.

nodes.label: basisIndication Interaction Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Provides immediate visual ripple and hover feedback; supports prefers-reduced-motion by suppressing ripple expansion animations.

nodes.label: basisPadding Spacing Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Applies spacing using typed Basis spacing tokens to guarantee visual rhythm and prevent accidental adjacent target activation.

nodes.label: basisSemantics Tree Manipulation Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Directly manipulates Compose accessibility tree, enabling merged descendants, custom action labels, and UI test tagging.
